record.reason: The stability of nonlinear dynamic systems is crucial in ensuring their performance and reliability across various engineering applications. This paper presents an enhanced methodology for stability analysis utilizing Hessian-based approaches. The proposed framework systematically investigates the second-order characteristics of nonlinear systems, providing deeper insights into their stability properties.
